description: Five role definitions per Paperclip company. Agent slot counts and model assignments.
_api_enum_compatibility: The Paperclip API restricts 'role' to a fixed enum. Spec names (Worker, Knowledge Keeper) don't match. Use paperclip_api_role when calling paperclip_create_agent. self_review_prohibited is not a platform field; embed it as instruction text in Reviewer's capabilities.

roles.purpose: Orchestrates all work via sub-issues. Never executes directly.
Executes tasks: code, file operations, research tasks delegated by CEO.
Sector scans, frontier patterns, gold-standard vetting. Hands findings to Knowledge Keeper.
Company-internal KB curation, decision capture, weekly delta to Knowledge central.
roles.model_note: latest takma adı kullanılmaz (geçersiz model id, PD'yi 5 hafta durdurdu)

roles.purpose: Independent quality gate. Reviews all deliverables before CEO reports done. Never self-reviews.
